text.en:
The Gulayan ng Masa and ISLA shall be rolled out into a massive
government food production program in the urban areas with the active participation of
the Department of Agriculture (DA), the local governments and the Philippine Gaming
Corporation (PAGCOR).

The rollout shall consist of the setting up of urban vegetable gardens and
backyard fisheries, including1 vacant lots and unused government land.

All governors and mayors are enjoined to set aside funding for the purpose
of the Gulayan ng Masa and ISLA in the urban areas. They are enjoined to designate
project supervisors in their respective areas.

There is hereby created a Steering Committee composed of the Secretwy
of Agriculture together with the Directors of the Bureaus of Fisheries and Aqut tic
Resources and Plant Industry, the Chairman of the Union of Local Authorities of 3 e
Philippines, the Chairman of PAGCOR, the Chancellor of the University of :he

Philippines in Los Baiios (UP-Los BaEios), and other concerned groups with the approval
of the President of the Philippines.

UP-Los Baiios and other state universities and colleges shall lend their
expertise in agriculture and aquaculture to the program.

The DA shall set up provisions for water sources and mobilize breeder
sanctuaries for the program.

The activities of the program shall include:
e Developing various modules for urban gardening
e Producing and disseminating information materials
Identifying beneficiaries, subject to the approval of the Office of the President for
the program components funded by the national government
Organizing seminars and site visits
e Distributing vegetable seedlings and tilapialhito fingerlings
e Monitoring local government progress
r Holding a search for the Best Urban Gardeflisheries

The funds for the program shall come fiom the PAGCOR and the local
governments, with the DA providing a one-is-to-one (1 : 1) counterpart.

This Order shall take effect immediately.
Manila, 16 January 2009
By the President:
Executive Secretary
